title: App. No. 18/517,204 — Self-leveling tent peg
forum: U.S. Patent and Trademark Office; fictional utility application

timeline.event: Client workplan signed; draft delivery agreed for ten days after reset

documents.title: Non-final Office action excerpt
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. Mailed seventy days before reset. The notice states a three-month shortened response period and six-month maximum. No extension is selected. The rejection concerns a self-leveling ring.

documents.title: Leveling-ring note
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. The ring floats on three captive beads. Wren proposes explaining why the cited peg lacks that arrangement; support in the original application must be checked.

documents.title: Agreed workplan
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. Workplan § 4: Counsel will deliver proposed amendments and an Office action response draft. Delivery is due ten calendar days after the demo reset date. This is an agreed draft-delivery milestone, separate from any filing deadline.

deadlines.label: Agreed delivery of tent-peg response draft

clientFacing.status: We are drafting a response about the leveling ring.
nextSteps: Confirm the ring description against the original drawings.
